description: Extend graph extraction to Python, Rust, and other languages via new code-graph scenarios; cartographer itself remains unchanged.

requirements.description: Graph extraction must be extensible to Python, Rust, and other languages by adding new code-graph scenarios (e.g., python-code-graph, rust-code-graph) that implement the same Connect-RPC graph extraction contract. Cartographer itself must require zero code changes to support new languages; only a new adapter registration is needed. This extensibility must be validated by architecture review, not by shipping additional language parsers within cartographer.
requirements.title: Additional Language Coverage via New Code-Graph Scenarios

validation.notes: Adapter registration mechanism accepts a new language adapter without modifying cartographer core code
Graph normalization model accepts nodes and edges from a mock third-language adapter without type errors
A stub python-code-graph fixture server implementing the graph extraction proto contract is correctly consumed by cartographer's adapter layer
Cartographer processes the stub Python graph through the full detection pipeline without language-specific code paths
Adding Python support requires only a new python-code-graph scenario and an adapter registration entry — no cartographer PR needed
Architecture review confirms cartographer core has zero language-specific conditional logic

title: Additional Language Coverage
